system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The agent prompt also derives the current data-source count from the loader registry
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt assembled at runtime from registries/skills; also worker prompts ordered so agent-invariant blocks form one cache-eligible prefix.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: a hash manifest over prompt, skills, tool registry and package versions
env_context_strategy.note: Not a code repository harness; environment context is market data via tools plus skills/memory injection. Low confidence.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Auto-compaction sliced the serialized history at a hard 80,000 characters before summarizing
context_compaction.note: Also `_microcompact()` clearing older tool results; oversized tool results paged/truncated with a cut notice.

observation_format.evidence_quote: strict JSON, non-finite floats serialize as `null`
observation_format.note: An `analyze_image` vision tool and llm-vision OCR also accept images as inputs.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: tool-call markup is never released as a final answer
tool_call_format.note: DeepSeek `DSML` tool-call parsing also mentioned (text-embedded markup), suggesting a text-parsing fallback.

tool_count.note: 74 is the MCP surface count at v0.1.14; the agent registry count is reported separately (e.g. 68 tools earlier).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: `write_file` safely recovers aliased or missing path arguments
edit_primitive.note: Only a write_file tool is evidenced; no search/replace or diff primitive appears in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: `build_registry()` no longer returns a short tool list in silence
tool_schema_source.note: MCP client-side discovery evidenced by 'a swarm MCP-discovery cache'; schema authorship mechanism not shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The MCP server now supports Streamable HTTP

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: event-driven and swarm runs now skip individual LLM content-moderation hits
loop_primitives.note: 'a retried worker no longer inheriting the failed attempt's report.md' -> multi_attempt; iteration loop ('reached max iterations') -> react.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: `run_research_autopilot` + `generate_backtest_config` wire **Hypothesis → Research Goal → backtest** end to end
planning_granularity.note: Hypothesis/Research Goal objects persisted and updated with backtest metrics.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: wired into **every market-data preset** (21 workers across 13 presets)
multi_agent_topology.note: Swarm presets with workers reachable via `run_swarm`; default single-session chat is single-agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: swarm workers use the shared truncation helper, so sub-agents always see the cut notice
delegation_mechanism.note: Swarm sub-agents spawned per preset task; not the default plain chat path.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: a second-confirmation dialog before committing a real trading mandate
human_in_loop.note: Live risk-increasing actions are mandate-gated with consent-first commits; also a user Stop button mid-stream.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: persisted run state is now fsync-durable
short_term_state.note: Sessions, runs, hypotheses, run cards and llm_usage.json are structured per-run state beyond messages.

long_term_memory.note: 88 bundled skills plus user skills; memory entries with `.md` suffix and an FTS5 session search index.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: The new `vibe-trading resume <session-id>` subcommand reopens that exact session and replays its recent turns into the loop

self_verification.evidence_quote: after every backtest the agent now runs **layered attribution** — trade-level winners/losers, beta regression, market-regime analysis, and a Monte Carlo permutation test
self_verification.note: Harness-run backtest/validation and a grounding gate that checks quoted numbers against recorded OHLC evidence; 'test_execution' is the closest value for backtest validation (see Ambiguities).

retry_policy.note: Swarm worker retry with artifact cleanup also evidenced; retry cap not stated.

rollback.evidence_quote: The new retry-time artifact cleanup ran `shutil.rmtree` on `run_dir/artifacts/<agent_id>`
rollback.note: Only artifact deletion between retries; no git reset, snapshot or undo mechanism appears in the evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: `reached max iterations` masking empty model responses
termination_condition.note: 'the agent stops when evidence is sufficient' -> model_declared; VIBE_TRADING_LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (default 300s) bounds a stalled call.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: worker prompts ordered so the agent-invariant blocks form one cache-eligible prefix
cost_controls.note: Also an opt-in market-data cache and a swarm MCP-discovery cache; QVeris cost quotes read from the marketplace with budget limits.

timeouts.note: Also 'a stuck read-only tool times out'; no run-level wall clock evidenced.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Generated backtests now inherit only an allowlisted subprocess environment instead of the parent secrets surface
execution_isolation.note: Runs locally via pip-installed CLI/desktop shell; Docker Compose deployment is also shipped.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: file tools got isolated read/write roots plus broader sandbox tests
filesystem_access.note: Relative to the host process; state under `~/.vibe-trading` (relocatable via VIBE_TRADING_HOME).

network_policy.note: Generated code has no network; agent tools reach allowlisted data/broker endpoints and the MCP network guard rejects internal hosts.

permission_model.evidence_quote: live risk-increasing actions remain mandate-gated and audited
permission_model.note: Signed exposure caps, atomic daily order limits, kill switch, fail-closed live state, plus an AST allow/deny sandbox for generated code.

tracing.evidence_quote: Every agent run now persists provider-reported token usage as a run-scoped `llm_usage.json`
tracing.note: Also durable traces, run cards, a hash manifest and a hash-chained audit ledger.

replayability.evidence_quote: reopens that exact session and replays its recent turns into the loop
replayability.note: Session resume/replay; market data is live so environment differs.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: **`alpha bench --strict`** finally wires the strict same-universe random-control + OOS gate
eval_hooks.note: Domain benchmarking (alpha bench / alpha compare / backtest validation) ships in-repo rather than an LLM-agent benchmark.

guardrails.note: Action policies: AST sandbox, mandate gate, fail-closed tool arguments, grounding gate refusing unsupported numeric claims.

target_domain.note: Domain is quantitative finance/trading (`other`), with research workflows and broad MCP tool use.

model_agnostic.note: Many providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Kimi, Gemini, Ollama, ModelScope, NVIDIA NIM ...) via a capability layer over LangChain.

first_release_date.note: Evidence shows v0.1.10–v0.1.14 releases from 2026-06-19 onward but no first tag date.

stars.note: No star count in the provided evidence.
